3. The Javascript ecosystem is huge in terms of components, libraries. ShadCN and what not.

4. Cloudflare has workers, durable objects which is isolated SQLite, D1 which is isolated SQLite

5. You can run crons, long running jobs, cloudlflare has emails.

6. Cloudlflare has best in class open weigh AI models as API for cheap.

7. Cloudflare has amazing CLI wrnagler but upcoming cf is purpose built for agentic workflows.

8. The built in AI assistant is really really good in guiding you how to setup, architecture and work around limitations etc.

Combine all the above, in next 5 years Cloureflare is going to get stronger with more workloads deployed to it then all three hyper clouds combined.
